authority: 2026-09-10 owner requested checking and mapping ETABS API operations from opening through analysis and closing, and identifying a more efficient API workflow.
objective: Make installed API discovery cover the lifecycle and the full interface surface, and integrate an evidence-backed efficiency and lifecycle plan into the existing workflow owner.
bounded_units: L1: static installed metadata and maintained caller inspection
L2: repeatable full-interface discovery with unclassified effects preserved
L3: lifecycle, efficiency, ownership and qualification map in existing documentation

acceptance_rows.outcome: Discovery records exact signatures, parameters, enums and registered-profile matches without constructing or invoking ETABS objects; unclassified methods are not inferred to be reads.

The default lifecycle catalogue and opt-in full-interface command retain explicit missing candidates, exclude property accessors from method enumeration, include inspection-profile comparisons and preserve runtime allowlists.
The installed DLL inventory is independently reconciled by interface/member/signature against reflection metadata; source and output hashes are retained externally with a safe receipt.

The maintained workflow distinguishes production reads, qualification scripts and metadata-only lifecycle operations; maps launch, attach, open/new, inventory, edits, save, analysis, design, results, export and exit.

Priorities address count-first connection, request bounds before allocation, shared property caching, result provenance and state invalidation. No unsupported solver cancellation, generic model Close or SQLite API claim is made.

Focused tests, locked build, installed static CLI reconciliation, documentation checks and required hosted checks pass. No ETABS COM call, current-model change, analysis/design run, application launch/exit or package installation occurs.

non_goals: Production mutation/lifecycle orchestration or changing existing getter/capture semantics
Engineering or solver changes, full beam/model support, full API behavioral qualification
Live ETABS calls, UI interaction, export of model data, package installation or release
Other worktrees, cleanup or a new competing programme plan
likely_pitfalls: Treating metadata presence or a matching signature as behavior qualification
Inferring no effects from a Get prefix or using a setter as proof of a getter
Claiming post-return row limits bound COM allocations
Using old web documentation instead of installed signatures
Confusing request cancellation with solver termination or detached COM with application exit

closeout_repair.cause: RR-040 details was a string rather than the required non-empty string list
closeout_repair.scope: Correct recurrence schema and coupled session/handoff evidence; preserve API implementation and installed metadata evidence
closeout_repair.acceptance: Maintained recurrence and newest-session parsers pass, repaired candidate integrity passes once, pre-push final closeout and hosted checks pass
closeout_repair.candidate_ceiling: One repair after the unpublished candidate closeout rejection

verification.installed: Static discovery only; independently reconcile exact interface/member/signature sets and unchanged assembly hashes.
